sampling_contract.analysis_weight: stage_windows, exactly once per sampled joint window

common_numeric_and_hardware_boundary.execution_lane: one identical Direct-legal single-port 1RW five-bank lane
common_numeric_and_hardware_boundary.numeric_order: real invalid mask; strict input-head 0..H-1 order per output tile; Acc32 modulo 2^32
forbidden: old scalar F/E recurrence as primary evidence

state_accounting.metadata_clock_tree_control_and_routing: must be separately included and may not be assigned zero cost

command_trace_contract.interval: half-open [start,end); reuse is legal exactly at end
command_trace_contract.phase_duration: strictly positive; zero-duration phases are forbidden
physical_resources: each Acc context and its five 1RW banks
command_trace_contract.fifo2_same_cycle_rule: enqueue is visible to a same-cycle dequeue; this is an explicit bypass; dequeue is checked after enqueue; final occupancy must be zero
command_trace_contract.slot_lifecycle: FREE -> FILL -> SEALED -> CONSUME -> FREE with no ownership gap
command_trace_contract.context_lifecycle: ownership starts at prepare and ends only after common-drain retirement
command_trace_contract.head_order: strict input-head 0..H-1 for each output tile
command_trace_contract.stripe_order: increasing output-tile pairs with explicit width-one remainder
record_checks: each replay read/enqueue/dequeue count equals epoch_records
command_trace_contract.direct_reconstruction: the future trace adapter must reconstruct each measured Direct task and full joint-window boundary exactly before any G0 row is admitted
command_trace_contract.required_trace_source: instrumented RTL phase and command trace; scalar duration substitution is not permitted

identity_keyed_service_contract.canonical_encoding: sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, uint64 length-prefixed hash frame
identity_keyed_service_contract.port_protocol: one outstanding request per physical service port; request identity remains stable until accepted; response remains stable until consumed; ports are independent
identity_keyed_service_contract.multiplicity: repeated complete logical identities require explicit unique non-negative occurrence fields
ledger_checks: common logical transaction identity-to-delay equality across candidates

c4_oracle.tie_break: minimize admitted records, then lexicographically smallest tuple of input-head indices
c4_oracle.metadata: tag and valid bits are reported separately and not deducted from the payload budget
c4_oracle.claim_boundary: payload-only relaxed oracle, not implementable same-bit hardware

c4_first_fit.policy: strict input-head-order first-fit; admit only positive-saved-cycle entries; no replacement or reconsideration

capacity_baseline_contract.g0_c4_mapping: statistics field c4 is exactly c4_oracle cycles; c4_first_fit and c5 are report-only

statistics_contract.weights: stage_windows applied once per joint window
statistics_contract.clusters: exactly 18 sequence_key clusters; every cluster contains all four stages
statistics_contract.bootstrap: paired complete-expansion sequence-cluster bootstrap with replacement, NumPy PCG64 seed 20260810, 20000 trials
statistics_contract.weighted_p95: left-continuous inverse empirical CDF using searchsorted-left
statistics_contract.stage_p95: four one-sided Bonferroni tests at alpha=0.0125 each; 98.75 percent upper bounds of C3-C0
statistics_contract.synergy: min(sum(w*C1),sum(w*C2))/sum(w*C3), recomputed inside every bootstrap replicate
statistics_contract.capacity_matched: sum(w*C4_oracle)/sum(w*C3), recomputed inside every bootstrap replicate
statistics_contract.exact_comparisons: no numeric tolerance; point thresholds use >=, CI lower bounds use strict >1.0, stage upper bounds use <=0

g0_profile_rtl_calibration_model.permission_on_pass: start minimum C0-C4 RTL only after independent review has no P0
g0_profile_rtl_calibration_model.permission_on_fail: do not implement EREP; preserve Local5 Direct and redirect architecture effort to Motion evidence or a newly preregistered candidate

g2_physical.energy_definition: weighted dynamic plus leakage energy per joint window, including logic, mapped SRAM and clock tree under the same activity trace
g2_physical.latency_definition: weighted wall-clock latency per joint window at the same target clock
g2_physical.timing_rule: failure to meet the common target clock fails G2; no candidate-only frequency down-bin
g2_physical.fairness: same process, voltage, SDC, SRAM macro rules, activity workload/hash and floorplan policy
g2_physical.asic_claim: requires DC plus STA plus SAIF plus PTPX

evidence_boundary: v3 freezes executable identity, statistics, capacity-baseline and command-lifecycle references before the formal result exists. It contains no formal joint-head result, no EREP RTL result and no ASIC PPA.
